note: Positive control for the AI sentence reviewer (review-sentences.ts, instructions v2). Made-up sentences written by hand, 10 known-bad and 10 known-good, mixed in two pantries in the same shape the reviewer sees in a real run. Written and committed before the reviewer saw any of them. 'expect' is the answer key: 'bad' items list the field the reviewer must set to true to count as caught ('catch'), plus any other field that is also a fair answer ('alsoOk'); 'good' items must have every field false. Dish states and missing lists are written by hand to match each pantry.
